license.clockHint: The license time decides when certificates expire and only moves forward with the server's running time. A forward change of the server clock is used only after it is verified; setting the clock back never extends a certificate, and setting it back too far is reported as a problem.
license.invalidSlotsWarning: This FE cannot verify the certificates below, so queries on this FE treat the license as invalid. Compare this FE's signing key fingerprint with the other FEs, check its signed trust manifest configuration and restart it.

verdict.UNKNOWN: Not compared (only the master compares, when its clock is off, and it needs at least three FEs)
verdict.OUTLIER: This FE differs from most FEs

clockStates.normal: Normal: the license time matches the server time.
clockStates.pending: Being verified: the server clock is {{forward}} ahead of the license time, verifying for {{age}}. Until it is verified, expiry is judged by the license time; if the server clock is set back, the change is dropped.
clockStates.pendingStartup: Being verified: at startup the server clock was {{forward}} ahead of the license time, verifying for {{age}}. This FE already uses it to judge expiry; the cluster adopts it only after it is verified.
clockStates.slowReported: Warning: this server's clock is behind the license time and may have been set back. This FE is not the master and does not reject queries because of it; correct the server time.
clockStates.slowSettling: Warning: this server's clock is behind the license time and may have been set back. Correct the server time before the startup observation period ends, or queries will be rejected after it.
clockStates.rejecting: Problem: this server's clock is behind the license time, so queries are rejected. Correct the server time; queries resume by themselves.
clockStates.committed: Problem: the cluster has marked the license time as abnormal, so every FE rejects queries. Correct the master's server time; queries resume by themselves.
clockStates.unavailable: The license time is not ready yet.

help.deployment_id: Created when licensing is first enabled on this cluster. Give it to the issuer when you request a certificate; certificates are valid only on this cluster.
help.highest_sequence: Certificates whose number is not higher cannot be imported.
help.clock_epoch: 0 means the license time was never repaired.
help.expansion_limit: Adding nodes is checked against this limit. It changes when a certificate takes effect.
help.confirmed_utc: The current time as confirmed by the license module. It never moves back with the server clock; forward changes count only after they are verified.
help.clock_local_suspect: Set back too far while running, or behind the recorded time at restart.
help.clock_committed_suspect: When yes, every FE rejects queries. It clears by itself once the master's server time is corrected.
help.clock_enforced: Yes on the master. Other FEs only report and never reject queries because of their own clock.
help.clock_settled: Within the observation period after startup, a slow clock only raises a warning.
help.trust_sha256: Should be the same on every FE; where it differs, that FE may not recognize certificates the master accepted.
help.replay_gaps: Each license record is a full snapshot, so the next one makes up for a skipped one; licensing is usually unaffected.
help.ignored_records: Records that did not match this cluster or were older than the current one; normally 0.

diagnosticsStates.normal: Normal: this FE can verify every certificate and has every license record.
diagnosticsStates.needsAction: Action needed: this FE cannot verify {{count}} certificate(s), so queries on this FE treat the license as invalid.
diagnosticsStates.notice: Note: this FE skipped or did not adopt license records while syncing; the next record usually makes up for it. See below and fe.log.

slotReasons.UNTRUSTED_KEY: Signing key unknown to this FE
slotReasons.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA: Not supported by this FE version
slotReasons.UNSUPPORTED_POLICY: Not supported by this FE version

receiptStates.APPLIED: In effect: this import has taken effect on this FE.
receiptStates.COMMITTED: Committed: the cluster accepted this import; this FE is still catching up and it will take effect shortly.
receiptStates.NOT_SUBMITTED: Not in effect: this import was not submitted. Fix the cause and import again.
receiptStates.UNKNOWN: Not confirmed yet: it is not certain whether this import took effect. Check again later and do not import it again.
receiptStates.OTHER: Unrecognized result; check it with SHOW LICENSE IMPORT.

license.title: License
license.intro: License status comes from this FE. Refresh manually to load the latest snapshot.
license.usageHint: Registered nodes / effective certificate limit. Offline nodes still count; capacity is released after a successful removal.
license.readOnly: Your account can view license status. Certificate details and imports require ADMIN privilege.
license.receiptHelp: Every import has a certificate fingerprint. When an import result cannot be confirmed at once (for example after a network failure), use the fingerprint to check whether that import took effect. Checking never imports again.
license.refreshRequired: Refresh to load the current session’s license status.
license.sessionChanged: The session or its permissions changed. Previous details and input were cleared. Refresh or sign in again.
license.appliedRefresh: The submission is applied on this FE. Refresh to view its current license status.
license.receiptUnconfirmed: The status cannot be confirmed right now. Refresh later and do not import the certificate again.
license.requestFailed: The license request could not be completed.
license.importHelp: Choose a UTF-8 certificate file or paste its text (maximum 64 KiB). Validate first, then explicitly confirm the import.
license.memoryOnly: The certificate is held only in this dialog’s temporary memory and cleared when closed, submitted, or signed out.
license.validated: Server validation passed. No certificate has been submitted yet.
license.confirmHelp: Confirm to persist this certificate and replace the current active and pending certificates. The server rechecks it against the state at import time and returns the actual changes; a coverage gap may leave queries unavailable.

changes.title: Importing replaces the current license with these changes
changes.warning: The new certificate replaces the current active and pending certificates. These changes take effect on import; re-importing an older certificate cannot undo them, only a new certificate with a higher sequence can. The import response is authoritative.
changes.none: No earlier expiry, lower limit, removed feature, coverage gap or discarded pending certificate compared with the current license.

codes.COVERAGE_GAP: {{gap}}-second coverage gap before the new certificate starts; queries are treated as expired during the gap
codes.PENDING_DISCARDED: Pending certificate {{licenseId}} (sequence {{sequence}}) is replaced and discarded

poll.waiting: Confirming the result automatically (up to 2 minutes). Leaving or hiding this page stops it.
poll.stopped: Automatic confirmation stopped. Click “Check result” to confirm manually.
poll.exhausted: No result within 2 minutes. The import status has not changed; check again later.

errors.LICENSE_INVALID_FILE: The file could not be read as UTF-8 text.
errors.LICENSE_NETWORK_ERROR: The request failed or timed out. Automatic checks stopped. If an import was in progress, query its fingerprint before submitting again.
errors.LICENSE_INVALID_RESPONSE: The server returned an unexpected response. Check the receipt if an import was in progress.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: ADMIN privilege is required. Previous details and input were cleared.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: The session expired. Sign in again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: The same-origin security check failed. Verify the reverse proxy preserves the original request origin.
errors.LICENSE_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN: The submission could not be confirmed. Query its receipt; do not assume it failed.
errors.LICENSE_IMPORT_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE: This submission cannot currently be confirmed from the available history.
errors.LICENSE_IMPORT_SUPERSEDED: This certificate's sequence is not above the highest accepted sequence: it has been superseded and will not be accepted, so do not retry. Import a certificate with a higher sequence.
errors.LICENSE_NOT_READY: License management is not ready. Retry later or query the receipt for an earlier submission.
errors.LICENSE_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Respect the server retry interval.
errors.LICENSE_RENEWAL_REDUCTION: A certificate that starts in the future cannot lower the current FE/BE limit. Issue it to start now, or import it once its start time arrives.
